        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for p in [1,2,3]:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    cnt=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); rc=cnt.most_common()[1][0]
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==rc]
    cs=[j for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==rc]
    blk=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for i in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
    bn=[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(blk) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=rc]
    bo=[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(go) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=1 and True]
    print(f'--- demo{p}: blk {len(blk)}x{len(blk[0])}, out {len(go)}x{len(go[0])}')
    print('blk noise:',bn)
    print('out noise:',[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(go) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=rc])

from collections import Counter
def cwrot(m): return [list(r) for r in zip(*m[::-1])]
def ccwrot(m): return [list(r) for r in zip(*m)][::-1]
def flipV(m): return m[::-1]
def flipH(m): return [r[::-1] for r in m]
def bbox_crop(g, rc):
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=rc]
    cs=[j for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=rc]
    return [[g[i][j] for j in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for i in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
ops={'I':lambda g:g,'CW':cwrot,'CCW':ccwrot,'R180':lambda m:[r[::-1] for r in m[::-1]],
     'T':lambda m:[list(r) for r in zip(*m)],'FV':flipV,'FH':flipH,'FT':lambda m:[list(r) for r in zip(*[r[::-1] for r in m])]}
for p in [1,2,3]:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    cnt=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); rc=cnt.most_common()[1][0]
    print(f'demo{p}:')
    for nm,f in ops.items():
        t=f(gi)
        c=bbox_crop(t, rc)
        if c==go: print('  MATCH:',nm)
    print()

def solve(gi):
    H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    # find background color = most common
    from collections import Counter
    bgc=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find the big rectangle: cells whose neighbors pattern... use: connected component of most common nonzero color (the rectangle color)
    colors=[v for v,c in Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common() if v!=bgc]
    main=colors[0]
    comp=[]; seen=set()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]==main and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; ccomp=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen or gi[y][x]!=main: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); ccomp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)): st.append((y+dy,x+dx))
    rs=[p[0] for p in ccomp]; cs=[p[1] for p in ccomp]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    h=r1-r0+1; w=c1-c0+1
    blk=[[gi[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    o=blk[::-1]  # default flipV
    if h==w: o=[list(r) for r in zip(*blk)]  # square: transpose
    elif h<w: o=[list(r) for r in zip(*blk)]  # wider: rotate? 
    return o, (h,w,len(blk),len(blk[0]))

    print(k,'shape',bh,bw,'out',len(out),len(out[0]),'matches:',matches)

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter

def noise_data(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; out=G[k+' output']
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mc=[v for v,c in cnt.most_common() if v!=bgc][0]
    rs=[p[0] for p in [(i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]==mc]]

    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1

    return bw,bh
# verify demos
